title: French Language – Level 04
overview: French Language – Level 04 is an intermediate-level program designed to strengthen learners’ independence and accuracy in everyday, social, academic, and professional French. Building on Level 03, participants develop more sustained conversation, greater control of complex sentence structures, the ability to explain opinions and experiences, and confidence when interpreting authentic spoken and written materials. The course integrates grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, listening, speaking, reading, and writing through practical, communicative activities.
audience: Learners who have completed French Language – Level 03 or demonstrate equivalent pre-intermediate proficiency; professionals, students, and individuals seeking more confident communication in French-speaking environments.
methodology: Communicative language teaching; guided conversation and role-play; task-based group activities; authentic audio and short texts; grammar discovery and controlled practice; vocabulary-building exercises; pronunciation workshops; reading and writing assignments; formative feedback; and integrated-skills assessments.
competencies: Intermediate conversational fluency and interactive listening
Accurate use of connected and complex French sentence patterns
Narrating events, explaining viewpoints, and supporting arguments
Reading comprehension and interpretation of practical texts
Clear paragraph writing and professional messages
objectives: Participate in extended discussions on familiar and moderately complex topics.
Use past, present, future, and conditional forms more accurately in context.
Express agreement, disagreement, preferences, reasons, and recommendations politely.
Understand main ideas and relevant details in authentic conversations and written materials.
Describe experiences, events, plans, and hypothetical situations with appropriate connectors.
Write coherent emails, narratives, descriptions, and short opinion texts.
Apply intermediate vocabulary and pronunciation strategies to workplace and social interactions.
